What it lacks in piercing power, it makes up for with the brutal wounds its dual ripping blades will inflict.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 18 |durability = 28 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Forked Lizal Spear}} Forked Lizal Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by high-tier [[Lizalfos]], such as [[Black Lizalfos]], [[Silver Lizalfos]], and [[Golden Lizalfos]]. [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] also use these Spears, especially in the [[Eldin Canyon]] and [[Akkala Highlands]]. They are wielded by skilled Lizalfos warriors, and their dual blades are known to inflict brutal wounds. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Due to their metal spearheads, Forked Lizal Spears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up again using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
